Review each locale tab and save.
id.When editing a product, click AI Transla:
When editing a product, click AI Translate under Translations.
Name, summary, description, ingredients, etc. are translated from the primary locale.
Review locale tabs before saving.
id.Pick document type (PI, CI, SC, etc.) an:
Pick document type (PI, CI, SC, etc.) and optional context.
AI drafts from current trade data and saves to the system.
Always verify fields in the document list before sending to customers.
id.Upload Excel, choose single or batch tra:
Upload Excel, choose single or batch translate mode.
AI translates headers or selected column keys — useful for reports and term sheets.
Download the result; try a small sample before batch jobs.
id.While editing content, enter a topic and:
While editing content, enter a topic and click Generate with AI to fill title, body, etc. (Chinese draft, no auto-translate).
Use AI Translate in the translations section for other locales after saving.
id.We use cookies to enhance your browsing: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. By clicking 'Accept All', you consent to our use of all cookies. You can choose 'Essential Only' to reject non-essential cookies.
id.Enter after sales verification for catal: Enter after sales verification for catalog display. You may state a specific reference (e.g. "25 business days after order confirmation") — do not use vague promises like "approx. X weeks". Leave blank or use "confirmed at order time" until verified.
id.1. Describe the product in natural langu:
1. Describe the product in natural language (specs, ingredients, packaging, certs).
2. Choose input language and click Generate with AI.
3. Review auto-filled fields on the right.
4. Click Save Product.
Use AI Translate for other locales after saving.
id.1. Select text in title, excerpt, or bod:
1. Select text in title, excerpt, or body.
2. Press Ctrl+K (Mac: ⌘K) to open the floating editor.
3. Describe the change (e.g. add compliance details, shorten title).
4. Preview before/after diff — Accept or Reject.
5. Repeat until satisfied, then publish.
id.1. Enter a topic or brief (any language):
1. Enter a topic or brief (any language) on the left.
2. Click Generate Chinese Draft for a zh-first article.
3. Review and edit the draft on the right.
4. Select text and press Ctrl+K (Mac: ⌘K) for inline AI edits.
5. Click Confirm & Publish to translate all locales and publish to the public blog.
id.Pick an Agent mode on the right, then ch:
Pick an Agent mode on the right, then chat:
• Chatbot: Q&A; optional order context.
• Plan-Execute-Replan / B2B Coordinator / Trade Assistant: streaming agents.
• Recommend / Search / Translate / Analyze inquiry / Generate quotation: one-shot JSON.
For Chatbot, select an order in the sidebar to discuss that order.
